identity.name: Bubba Gump Performance Hub
identity.aesthetic: Corporate Coastal - Clean lines, ample whitespace, warm accents
identity.design_philosophy: Clarity first. Data should be breathable. Dark mode should be 'dim' not 'black'.

font_family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

usage.h1: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground font-serif

stats_card.structure: flex items-center justify-between p-6 bg-card rounded-xl border border-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

upload_zone.container: relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-64 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-muted-foreground/25 bg-muted/30 hover:bg-muted/50 hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.outline: border-2 border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-11 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 rounded-full font-medium

tables.container: w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-sm
tables.header: bg-muted/50 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider

instructions_to_main_agent: UPDATE tailwind.config.js to use the new color palette defined in 'colors.theme_light' and 'colors.theme_dark'. Specifically, lighten the dark mode background from #0B1220 to #0F172A (Slate 900) and cards to #1E293B (Slate 800).
REFACTOR src/components/StatsCard.js to match the 'stats_card' component definition. Remove the old centered layout and use the new flex layout with icon on the left.
REFACTOR the upload zone in src/pages/Dashboard.js (or wherever it resides) to use the 'upload_zone' styles. Make it cleaner and less 'heavy'.
UPDATE src/index.css to apply the new global font settings and base styles.
ENSURE all buttons use the 'rounded-full' class to match the friendly Bubba Gump brand.
USE 'Merriweather' for all headings (h1-h3) and 'Inter' for body text.
ADD 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements as per the universal guidelines.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for main backgrounds, use solid colors or very subtle noise textures.
Ensure text contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text).
Use 'lucide-react' for icons if available, otherwise stick to the existing library but ensure consistent sizing.
Avoid 'pure black' (#000000) in dark mode; use Slate-900 or Slate-950.
Avoid 'pure white' (#FFFFFF) text on dark backgrounds; use Slate-50 or Slate-100 to reduce eye strain.
